verses.english: The All-beneficent
has taught the Quran.
He created man,
[and] taught him articulate speech.
The sun and the moon are [disposed] calculatedly,
and the herb and the tree prostrate [to Allah].
He raised the heaven high and set up the balance,
declaring, ‘Do not infringe the balance!

verses.arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.english: Maintain the weights with justice, and do not shorten the balance!’
verses.transliteration_html: Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana
verses.transliteration_text: Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana

verses.english: And the earth—He laid it out for mankind.
In it are fruits and date-palms with sheaths,
grain with husk, and fragrant herbs.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
He created man out of dry clay, like the potter’s,

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
verses.english: and created the jinn out of a flame of a fire.
verses.transliteration_html: Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin
verses.transliteration_text: Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
Lord of the two easts, and Lord of the two wests!
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
He merged the two seas, meeting each other.
There is a barrier between them, which they do not overstep.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
From them emerge the pearl and the coral.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
verses.english: His are the sailing ships on the sea [appearing] like landmarks.
verses.transliteration_html: Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami
verses.transliteration_text: Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
Everyone on it is ephemeral,

verses.arabic: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.english: yet lasting is the majestic and munificent Face of your Lord.
verses.transliteration_text: Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thoo aljalali waalikrami

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
verses.english: Everyone in the heavens and the earth asks Him. Every day He is engaged in some work.
verses.transliteration_html: Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin
verses.transliteration_text: Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
Soon We shall make Ourselves unoccupied for you, O you notable two!
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ
verses.english: O company of jinn and humans! If you can pass through the confines of the heavens and the earth, then do pass through. But you will not pass through except by an authority [from Allah].
verses.transliteration_html: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin
verses.transliteration_text: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
verses.english: There will be unleashed upon you a flash of fire and a smoke; then you will not be able to help one another.
verses.transliteration_html: Yursalu AAalaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasirani
verses.transliteration_text: Yursalu AAalaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasirani

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
verses.english: When the sky is split open, and turns crimson like tanned leather.
verses.transliteration_html: Faitha inshaqqati alssamao fakanat wardatan kaalddihani
verses.transliteration_text: Faitha inshaqqati alssamao fakanat wardatan kaalddihani

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.english: On that day neither humans will be questioned about their sins nor jinn.
verses.transliteration_html: Fayawmaithin la yusalu AAan thanbihi insun wala jannun
verses.transliteration_text: Fayawmaithin la yusalu AAan thanbihi insun wala jannun

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
verses.english: The guilty will be recognized by their mark; so they will be seized by their forelocks and feet.
verses.transliteration_html: YuAArafu almujrimoona biseemahum fayukhathu bialnnawasee waalaqdami
verses.transliteration_text: YuAArafu almujrimoona biseemahum fayukhathu bialnnawasee waalaqdami

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.english: ‘This is the hell which the guilty would deny!’
verses.transliteration_html: Hathihi jahannamu allatee yukaththibu biha almujrimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Hathihi jahannamu allatee yukaththibu biha almujrimoona

verses.english: They shall circuit between it and boiling hot water.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
For him who stands in awe of his Lord will be two gardens.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
Both abounding in branches.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
In both of them will be two flowing springs.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
In both of them will be two kinds of every fruit.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
verses.english: [They will be] reclining on beds lined with green silk. And the fruit of the two gardens will be near at hand.
verses.transliteration_html: Muttakieena AAala furushin batainuha min istabraqin wajana aljannatayni danin
verses.transliteration_text: Muttakieena AAala furushin batainuha min istabraqin wajana aljannatayni danin

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.english: In them are maidens of restrained glances, whom no human has touched before, nor jinn.
verses.transliteration_html: Feehinna qasiratu alttarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
verses.transliteration_text: Feehinna qasiratu alttarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
As though they were rubies and corals.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
Is the requital of goodness anything but goodness?
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
Beside these two, there will be two [other] gardens.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
Dark green.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
In both of them will be two gushing springs.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
In both of them will be fruits, date-palms and pomegranates.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
In them are maidens good and lovely.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?
Houris secluded in pavilions.
So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.english: Whom no human has touched before, nor jinn.
verses.transliteration_html: Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
verses.transliteration_text: Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ
verses.english: Reclining on green cushions and lovely carpets.
verses.transliteration_text: Muttakieena AAala rafrafin khudrin waAAabqariyyin hisanin

verses.english: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny?

verses.arabic: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.english: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, the Majestic and the Munificent!
verses.transliteration_text: Tabaraka ismu rabbika thee aljalali waalikrami
